Package dayplanner

Class OtherActivity

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.Activity
dayplanner.OtherActivity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Activity>
public class OtherActivity extends Activity

Represents an activity outside the home and school categories, with an associated location such as a clinic or gym. Common fields and behavior are inherited from Activity.

Example:

new OtherActivity("Appointment", start, end, "Clinic")
